info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Billing Review Submission API
info.description: The Corporate Billing Review Submission API allows businesses to submit reviews related to their corporate billing services. Typically used by finance or billing departments, this API streamlines feedback collection and enhances service improvements. Users can contribute insights about their experiences, helping the organization to better understand client needs and to refine billing processes. This facilitates a stronger relationship with clients through transparent communication and responsiveness to concerns.

post.summary: Submit a review for a corporate billing transaction.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit reviews for a specific corporate billing transaction identified by its payment ID. Providing feedback helps improve service quality and addresses customer concerns effectively.
